note: Hosts that the recipe-finder skill may show as actionable links (engine repos, weights, downloads). A subdomain of a listed host is also trusted. Every other host is 'unverified': the skill shows it only as a source to read. Add a host only when it is the official home of an engine, a model hub, or a hardware vendor. scripts/url_safety.py reads this file.

verified_hub_owners._note: Hugging Face / ModelScope owners that the data names only in notes. Add an owner only after you open its hub page. Owners of model cards in model-params.json and of recipe source URLs on the hubs are known automatically.
